subject.title: fix(ios): typography audit rejects localized accessibility labels

question: Should this PR proceed with the bounded lexical scanner once the refreshed native gates pass, or should the typography audit use a different parsing strategy before merge?
rationale: The implementation is behaviorally proven and no concrete defect remains, but accepting a custom Swift syntax classifier as long-term audit infrastructure is an ownership and maintenance-risk choice.

options.title: Accept after native gates
options.body: Refresh the branch, require the queued iOS and shared-kit scan gates to pass, then merge the tested bounded classifier.

options.title: Require parser redesign
options.body: Pause merge and replace the lexical heuristic with a maintainer-approved parsing strategy if its future syntax-drift risk is unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept after native gates
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, require the queued iOS and shared-kit scan gates to pass, then merge the tested bounded classifier.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to both the localized accessibility forms and the typography-audit repair.
